title: Grusch uses the data to find 40 witnesses

tellings.quote: Dave basically ran with our data mine and house and uh found everything found 40 Witnesses

plain: David Grusch, a former Air Force intelligence officer who says the US holds non-human craft, took a body of data collected in-house by Eric W. Davis and a physicist named Hal Puthoff and used it to find 40 witnesses. Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon studies of unexplained aerial reports, tells Michels this, saying Grusch "ran with our data mine." If true, it would tie Grusch's witnesses to records these two scientists had already gathered.
